name: Ravenshade Asylum
summary:
Ravenshade Asylum is a psychological horror experience inspired by classic Silent Hill atmosphere and analog horror storytelling. Explore the abandoned halls of Ravenshade Asylum, uncover hidden records, disturbing experiments, and the truth behind a secret cult that turned treatment into something far more terrifying.

As you descend deeper into the asylum, reality begins to distort. Strange whispers echo through empty corridors, shadows linger in forgotten rooms, and the line between hallucination and reality slowly disappears. The patients were never meant to be cured. They were part of something far darker.
